title: John Ternus says Apple expects memory costs to increase into December and beyond; Apple's inventory grew to $14.54B in Q4, up 31.1% QoQ and 154.3% YoY (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
summary: Sarah Perez / TechCrunch: John Ternus says Apple expects memory costs to increase into December and beyond; Apple's inventory grew to $14.54B in Q4, up 31.1% QoQ and 154.3% YoY — Apple's stockpiling of inventory, particularly computer memory, continued in its fiscal fourth-quarter, according to earnings reported Monday.
